name: Pearl
title: Gloom Stalker Ranger
role: The party's archer: first to act, Titanstring Bow powered by Strength from gear, a shield on her back for AC.

shape.name: Titanstring archer
shape.summary: Titanstring Bow adds her Strength modifier to every arrow, and gear sets her Strength high: the Club of Hill Giant Strength from Act 1, then optionally the Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength in Act 3. A shield in the melee slot keeps its AC while she shoots.
strong: Huge first turn: Dread Ambusher adds an extra attack, and she almost always goes first.
Strength from gear means dumping STR costs nothing.
Iron Mind (level 7) protects her from Hold Person and other mind control.
weak: Only 2 attacks on later turns until Stalker's Flurry at 11.

choices.label: Strength source
options: Club of Hill Giant Strength (Act 1, Arcane Tower): STR 19, +4 per arrow, in the melee slot with a shield
Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength (Act 3, House of Hope): STR 23, +6 per arrow, but they take the gloves slot
choices.note: Strength sources set your score rather than add to it, so the highest one wins. Dump STR to 8.

choices.label: Ability scores
options: DEX 17 · CON 16 · WIS 14 (+ STR 8, INT 8, CHA 10): sturdier
DEX 16 · CON 14 · WIS 16: stronger Ensnaring Strike
choices.note: Auntie Ethel's hair can add +1 DEX.

choices.label: Armour
options: Medium armour that adds full DEX (Yuan-Ti, Armour of Agility, Unwanted Masterwork) and a shield
Heavy armour through the Ranger Knight favoured enemy: the Club's STR 19 meets heavy armour's Strength needs, but it gives Disadvantage on Stealth

choices.label: Favoured Enemy
options: Bounty Hunter: Ensnaring Strike targets have Disadvantage on the save
Keeper of the Veil: Protection from Evil and Good

choices.label: Natural Explorer
options: Beast Tamer: Find Familiar (a raven can blind enemies)
Wasteland Wanderer: resistance to Fire, Cold or Poison
Urban Tracker: Sleight of Hand proficiency

tips: You pick a Favoured Enemy and a Natural Explorer again at levels 6 and 10.

choices.label: Fighting style
options: Archery: +2 to ranged attack rolls, offsetting Sharpshooter

tips: Vesper's plan counts on your Longstrider each morning for her hit-and-run.
Dread Ambusher: +3 initiative, and on the first turn of combat +3 m movement and a free extra attack with +1d8. Special arrows can't be used for that extra attack.
levels.gains: Dread Ambusher, Umbral Shroud and Disguise Self, always prepared.

choices.label: Feat
options: Sharpshooter: −5 to hit, +10 damage, toggled per attack

tips: Sharpshooter pays off once you have Archery and something else to hit with: Advantage, Guiding Bolt from Alene, or +1 attack gear.

levels.gains: Extra Attack (3 attacks on your first turn) and Misty Step, always prepared.
A second Favoured Enemy and Natural Explorer.
Iron Mind: proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence saves.
Feat, and difficult terrain no longer slows you.

tips: Fear is an illusion spell: with Band of the Mystic Scoundrel you can cast it as a bonus action after a hit.

levels.gains: Hide in Plain Sight, and a third Favoured Enemy and Natural Explorer.

tips: Stalker's Flurry: when you miss with a weapon attack, you get a free extra attack. That makes Sharpshooter's −5 much less painful.

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Titanstring from Brem plus the Club gets the build going early.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: Accuracy and crit pieces arrive to offset Sharpshooter.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: If you take the Gauntlets, the Club's slot frees up and your gloves slot is spoken for.

turn: First turn: Hunter's Mark on the biggest threat (bonus action), then spend Dread Ambusher's free extra attack on it.
Ensnaring Strike instead of Hunter's Mark when one enemy needs holding in place.
Toggle Sharpshooter on when your hit chance is high: Advantage, Guiding Bolt from Alene, Faerie Fire.
Arrow of Many Targets spreads every on-hit rider (Caustic Band acid, Reverberation) across several enemies.
start_of_day: Club in the main hand and a shield in the off hand: the Strength and the AC both apply while you shoot.
Cast Longstrider on the party; Vesper's hit-and-run counts on it.
With Beast Tamer, summon your familiar; a raven can blind enemies.
tips: Special arrows can't be used with Dread Ambusher's free extra attack.
Pass Without Trace gives the party +10 Stealth: easy surprise rounds.
Plant Growth (level 9+) quarters enemy speed with no concentration.
A teammate's Drakethroat Glaive can make your bow deal elemental damage, which feeds Belligerent Skies or the Snowburst Ring (the video's trick; test it).
